addons.name: Local Gitea VM
addons.description: Install/start an independent Fedora 45 Git server outside CRC. Repositories and files use NFS on this host. Disable stops the VM and retains data; no CI runner is installed.
addons.availability: Linux x86_64, KVM/system libvirt and an active host NFS server required; 2 CPUs, 2 GiB RAM

addons.name: Lightwell CI/CD Demo
addons.description: Configure pinned upstream CI/CD templates and an approval-gated AO workflow. Lightwell is a patch simulation, not a backport service; AO automatically enables the EDA service but creates no event source or rulebook activation. Requires prepared Gitea, OpenFlake and one dedicated RHEL host.
addons.availability: Prepared external services and AAP credentials required; enabling launches no deployment jobs

addons.name: AAP MCP Server
addons.description: Expose AAP tools and resources to MCP-compatible AI clients.

addons.name: Automation Orchestrator
addons.description: Install Automation Orchestrator and connect it to AAP and MCP.

addons.name: AO PR Testing
addons.description: Add the local OpenShift MCP server and a PR-driven AO validation workflow.

addons.name: Ollama
addons.description: Run the local qwen2.5:3b LLM provider used by AO.

addons.name: Ansible Lightspeed
addons.description: Deploy the Lightspeed intelligent assistant in AAP, backed by the local Ollama LLM.

addons.name: Self-Service Portal
addons.description: Deploy the Helm-based AAP self-service portal.

addons.name: Portal Operator
addons.description: Deploy the AMD64-only Automation Portal Operator technology preview.

addons.name: APME Early Access
addons.description: Deploy the early-access APME portal integration.

addons.name: Ansible Product Demos
addons.description: Install the non-Satellite demo domains, templates, and content; reconcile existing Fleet nodes into the AAP Fleet inventory.

addons.name: Event-Driven Ansible
addons.description: Enable AAP Event-Driven Ansible. This does not create an event source, external broker, or rulebook activation.

addons.name: Satellite Demo
addons.description: Install Satellite demo content using the local lab or an external Satellite server. The local lab can optionally image-provision three small general VMs through its selected Satellite compute resource.
addons.availability: Requires a managed local Satellite lab or an external Satellite server

addons.name: Infrastructure Demo
addons.description: Import the upstream Infrastructure setup template only. It is separately opted in and is never launched automatically.
addons.availability: Cloud, broker, and managed-host prerequisites are supplied by the operator before launching the template.

addons.name: Guarded EDA Demo
addons.description: Import the Event-Driven Ansible scenario only with PRODUCT_DEMOS_ENABLE_EDA=true; no external broker, cloud resource, or rulebook activation is created.
addons.availability: Explicit opt-in plus configured external event-source prerequisites required.

addons.name: Private Automation Hub Setup
addons.description: Validate the Vault-backed Automation Hub offline token, configure both Red Hat remotes, and wait for their Pulp sync tasks to complete.

addons.name: Open Policy Agent
addons.description: Deploy OPA and configure policy integration with AAP.

addons.name: AAP Fleet
addons.description: Manage local RHEL QEMU nodes for AAP demonstrations.

addons.name: Keycloak OIDC
addons.description: Deploy a Keycloak OIDC provider for local AAP/AO authentication tests.

addons.name: Local Image Cache
addons.description: Cache deployment container images for faster rebuilds.

addons.name: Satellite Build and Configure
addons.description: Build a Red Hat Satellite 6 demo lab on this host: generate the subscription manifest, provision the Satellite VM, and configure content, provisioning, and AAP integration via the satellite-lab workflow.

addons.name: OpenShift Delivery Proof of Concept
addons.description: Optionally install the owned Red Hat OpenShift GitOps and Pipelines operator subscriptions. It discovers supported catalog channels and creates no repository, Argo CD Application, PipelineRun, credential, or workload.
addons.availability: Requires OLM and a reachable Red Hat operator CatalogSource; reserves about 4 GiB RAM and 14 GiB VM storage.

addons.name: OpenShift Security Proof of Concept
addons.description: Optionally install the owned Red Hat Advanced Cluster Security Operator subscription. It discovers a supported catalog channel and creates no Central, SecuredCluster, init bundle, policy, scan, credential, integration, or customer workload.
addons.availability: Requires OLM and a reachable Red Hat operator CatalogSource; reserves about 2 GiB RAM and 4 GiB VM storage.
